'''Mijos''' was a [[Swamp/Legends|swampy]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and a stopover point for travel between the planets [[Lutrillia/Legends|Lutrillia]] and [[Gerrenthum/Legends|Gerrenthum]] on the [[Lutrillian Cross/Legends|Lutrillian Cross]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]. A number of [[Lutrillian/Legends|Lutrillian]]-run [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] could be found on Mijos, but poor structural planning had caused many of these [[City/Legends|settlements]] to sink into the planet's muck.

==Description==
The [[Swamp/Legends|swampy]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Mijos was located in the [[Mijos system/Legends|Mijos system]] of the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]], within the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" /> and [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion<ref name="Atlas" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was positioned between the fragmented portions of the [[Kiax Nebula/Legends|Kiax Nebula]] on the border of the [[Yarith sector/Legends|Yarith sector]].<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />

Mijos sat at the intersection of two [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]], the [[Lutrillian Cross/Legends|Lutrillian Cross]] and [["The Loop" (hyperlane)|"The Loop."]] The former split the Kiax to connect Mijos with the planet [[Lutrillia/Legends|Lutrillia]] as well as the megaworld [[Gerrenthum/Legends|Gerrenthum]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the Anoat [[Sector/Legends|sector]]; the latter circled the Kiax to link Mijos with the planet [[Shuldene/Legends|Shuldene]] en route to the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />

==History==
The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] expansion into the Greater Javin a [[Millennium/Legends|millennium]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]
initially met the challenge of the region's [[Twin Nebulae/Legends|Twin Nebulae]], Kiax and [[Ivax Nebula/Legends|Ivax]]. Mijos and other planets lay barricaded among these vast [[Nebula/Legends|gas clouds]], where [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Scout/Legends|explorers]], hungry to open the region to greater [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] opportunities, could not efficiently reach.<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />

After [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] of failed attempts by his predecessors, the entrepreneur [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg]] finally succeeded in blazing hyperlanes straight through the Kiax Nebula to reach these formerly inaccessible worlds. In particular, the new Lutrillian Cross allowed travelers on the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] to access the [[Lutrillian/Legends|Lutrillian]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of Lutrillia by way of Mijos. With Figg's success, the Greater Javin exploded into an economic powerhouse. Originally part of the Republic's [[Javin sector/Legends|Javin sector]], Mijos was reorganized into the new Anoat sector<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" /> circa [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]].<ref name="Date">"[[Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin]]," which is set during the [[Rebellion era|Rebellion]] and [[New Republic era]]s ([[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]&ndash;[[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]; see {{Blog|holocron|24|Star Wars Eras}}), states that the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]] was established in the last [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg's]] life. The text states that Figg [[Death/Legends|died]] nearly four [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] prior to its setting, thus providing an approximate date of [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]] for the Anoat [[Sector/Legends|sector's]] establishment.</ref>

==Locations==
Mijos featured a number of Lutrillian-operated [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]]. However, many of the [[City/Legends|settlements]] sank into the planet's swampy muck due to poor structural planning.<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mijos was created for "[[Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin]]," a [[2004]] [[Wizards.com|online]] supplement for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />
